instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Design a pipelined module that implements a 3-bit priority encoder. The module should have three inputs (A2, A1, and A0) and two outputs (EN and Y). If all inputs are 0, EN should be 0 and Y should be 000. If A2 is 1 and A1 and A0 are 0, EN should be 1 and Y should be 100. If A2 and A1 are 1 and A0 is 0, EN should be 1 and Y should be 110. If all inputs are 1, EN should be 1 and Y should be 111. 
Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
